description: Selected third 13-class P39 wrapper registration/control handoff after the third finite synthetic thinning, statistics, and GM-enabled membership pass.

input_materialization.membership_state: Output of the Java-matched third-thinning -> statistics -> GM-enabled membership pass, rebuilt and asserted in the focused test.
input_materialization.synthetic_membership_note: The 13 class membership channels equal the previous synthetic pass bit-for-bit, but the lesion auxiliary map changes in the following refresh; this is only a partial fixed point.
input_materialization.geometry: 17x17x17 identity affine in RAS, matching the other finite 13-class synthetic fixtures.

source_call_order: registerShapes using unchanged atlas-space priors and the prior transform
transform atlas priors using the third registerShapes transform/bounds

registration.initial_transform: The transform returned by the second selected synthetic registerShapes call.
reference_fields: initial energy, gradient, and diagonal Hessian
every candidate transform, source acceptance/rejection, energy and optimizer iteration value
final transform, rotation, and per-class bounds

control.expected: nonterminal no-stop decision; selected standard mode enters propagateGrowing and refreshes relations
control.following_thinning: Uses the third registration's transformed atlas maps and the actual grown segmentation/frontier; Java queue, topology events, final arrays and residue match byte-for-byte.
control.fixed_point_check: Following thinning output differs from the preceding thinning reference, so this is another finite state transition rather than a repeated unchanged result.

post_thinning_refresh.java_reference: All selected statistics, membership, auxiliary map, objective and energy-ratio outputs are compared with the pinned Java excerpts.
post_thinning_refresh.state_transition: Class membership maps and objective are bit-identical to the preceding membership state, but the lesion auxiliary membership changes and matches Java; this is a partial fixed point and the full state advances.

java_reference.kind: Hand-coded selected Java formula excerpts using the pinned upstream ParametricTransform, RotationMatrix, ImageFunctions, Numerics and wrapper control sources; not execution of the full wrapper/class.

scope_limitations: The reference covers this finite third registration trace, the no-stop growth/relation branch, one following thinning pass, and the next statistics/membership energy refresh; later registration/control is outside this fixture.
Class membership channels and objective are stable in the final tested refresh, but the lesion auxiliary changes, so the full 13-class state is not at a fixed point.
The Java references are selected formula excerpts, not execution of the complete wrapper or LesionTOADS class, and this is not full LesionTOADS equivalence.
No real atlas or patient imaging is represented.
